svg.title: Lightest Feature That Fits
svg.desc: A decision path for choosing a feature: recurring files and rules lead to a Project, an answer spread across many sources to Research, numbers to calculate from a file to code execution, something to keep or share to an artifact, and otherwise a plain chat with web search; a procedure repeated the same way is a skill.
svg.text: Answer each question; stop at the first yes.
Paid plans; web search on; uses limits faster
Add web search for current facts
Same procedure every time, in any chat?
